description: This file defines the StyleRenderer class responsible for rendering style objects to RTF format within the MigraDoc library. It manages rendering of character and paragraph styles, including their base styles, fonts, and formatting details.

classes.name: StyleRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a Style object into RTF format, handling style-specific details such as style type, base styles, and associated font or paragraph formats.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the style to RTF output, including style control words, base style references, and style-specific content.
